NOTICE UNDER SECTION 289 OF THE COMPANIES ACT 1994
FOR RESOLUTION TO WIND UP VOLUNTARILY
In the matter of
KJS ENTERPRISE LIMITED
An extraordinary general meeting of the shareholders of KJS ENTERPRISE
LIMITED duly convened and held at the Registered office of the Company in
Dhaka on 20-04-2026 at 10.00 A.M. It has been resolved that KJS ENTERPRISE
LIMITED (Reg. No. C-114331), Reg. Date: 25-FEB-2014, has been put into
Members for voluntary Winding up on 20-04-2026. Mr. Saifullah Abdullah
Solenkhi, Managing Director, KJS ENTERPRISE LIMITED, Address:
242 Gulshan, Tejgaon Link Road, (1st Floor), Tejgaon I/A, Dhaka, Bangladesh,
has been appointed as the Liquidator of the Company.
All concerned are therefore, requested to contact henceforth with the Liquidator
in respect of any affairs of the company.
KHILFAT JAHAN JOHAIRA
Director
KJS ENTERPRISE LIMITED.
